rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for insurance coverage; in a metaphorical context it can also mean a precaution or safeguard, while 保單 is more precise for the policy document.

example.english: I bought insurance, so I feel more at ease when travelling.
example.traditional: 我買咗保險，去旅行安心啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou2 him2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 on1 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use this when you mean the actual insurance policy or policy document rather than insurance coverage in general.

example.english: Where did you put your insurance policy?
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 bou2 daan1 fong3 zo2 hai2 bin1 dou6
